services.name: Pastries & Croissants

testimonials.name: Sarah N.
testimonials.text: The two-tier cake came out exactly like the photo I sent on WhatsApp, and it was ready a day early. The kids finished every crumb.

testimonials.name: David O.
testimonials.text: Our breakfast trays arrive warm every Friday before 8 AM. One message the day before and everything is sorted — no follow-ups needed.

testimonials.text: They sat with us for the tasting, adjusted the design twice without complaining, and set the cake up at the venue on time. Guests kept asking who made it.
